answer: I ran a 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on qubit 0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, and a measurement of all 3 qubits. Qiskit transpile against the IQM backend added the MOVE gates that the Star QPU needs. Job 01a15f39-d44f-778d-a180-36badb99dc52 finished with success=True. The counts were {"000": 200}. These counts come from the mock backend, so they do not show real GHZ statistics. A real QPU should return mostly 000 and 111. The job was free because it ran on a mock alias. The script is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-7/run_ghz.py.
